class.name: ResonanceBakeConfig
class.brief_description: Per-volume bake quality settings for Steam Audio probes.
class.description: Assign to [member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_config]. Auto-created when empty in the editor; save as .tres for presets. When null at bake time, [method create_default] is used. Controls rays, bounces, threads, and optional Bake Ambisonic Order. Reflection type and pathing on/off follow [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url] on [ResonanceRuntime] (legacy [member reflection_type] / [member pathing_enabled] are ignored for gating). Static passes follow [member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_sources] / [member bake_listeners].

method.name: get_bake_params
method.description: Bake quality dictionary (rays, bounces, threads, Ambisonic Order, reflection type). Pathing visibility keys come from [url=#ResonanceRuntimeConfig]ResonanceRuntimeConfig[/url] at bake time.

method.name: create_default
method.description: Default config when [member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_config] is null.

members.member: Legacy serialization field. Ignored for bake gating; bake uses [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.reflection_type] (TAN maps to Convolution). Hidden in the inspector.
Legacy serialization field. Ignored for bake gating; pathing follows [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.pathing_enabled]. Hidden in the inspector.
Legacy flag. Ignored for bake gating; STATICSOURCE runs when [member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_sources] has a valid [ResonancePlayer]. Hidden in the inspector.
Legacy flag. Ignored for bake gating; STATICLISTENER runs when [member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_listeners] has a valid [ResonanceListener]. Hidden in the inspector.

[code]0[/code] Use Global ([member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.bake_ambisonic_order]), [code]1[/code]-[code]3[/code] override. Mismatch vs [member ResonanceProbeData.baked_ambisonics_order] warns; playback uses [code]min(baked, realtime)[/code].
Reflection rays per probe (256-16384). More rays = higher quality, longer bake.
Reflection bounces per ray (1-32). More bounces = longer reverb tail and bake.
Parallel bake worker threads (1-64). Affects duration only; not in probe outdated hashes.
